throughput.title: llama.cpp throughput, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE, UD-Q5_K_XL)
throughput.subtitle: llama-bench, flash attention on, all layers on the GPU; mean of interleaved runs
throughput.desc: Prompt processing pp512: system Mesa 217.6, 20e478a 271.0, coopmat-27 271.2 tokens per second. Decode tg128: system Mesa 25.5, 20e478a 29.7, coopmat-27 30.2 tokens per second.
throughput.note:
M1 Max Mac Studio (64 GB), Fedora Asahi Remix 44, Asahi 7.3 kernel, llama.cpp 9a080f44b (2026-11-19).
20e478a and coopmat-27: two interleaved runs of 3 repetitions each; system Mesa: one run of 3.

tbo.title: ggml test-backend-ops: failing cases (Vulkan vs CPU)
tbo.subtitle: Lower is better. 0 means every case passed.
tbo.desc: Failing cases: system Mesa 0 of 8848; 71969e3 682 of 8848; 20e478a 0 of 8848 and 0 of 23116; coopmat-27 0 of 12418 and 0 of 23116.
tbo.note:
71969e3 failed q5_0/q5_1 KV flash attention (674) and iq3_s GET_ROWS (8): a base predating upstream AGX fix bbeb2dca.
Sweeps: 18 and 29 ggml ops; full suite: llama.cpp 9a080f44b, coopmat-27 as built by the mesa-coopmat RPM.

barrier.title: Cost of one dependent compute dispatch
barrier.subtitle: Barrier plus drain between two dependent dispatches, 1-64 workgroups (whisker: range)
barrier.desc: Full CDM barrier 4.05-4.25 microseconds, light barrier 0x17f 3.11-3.19, wait bit only 1.84-2.09 (not adopted), no barrier 0.13 (incorrect results).
barrier.note: Microbenchmark on an M1 Max MacBook Pro, Asahi 7.1 kernel. Decode gain of the light barrier in llama.cpp: +1.2 to +2.6 %.
